in_arabic.name: Nousha
in_arabic.long_meaning: Nousha هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'naws' meaning 'to be light' or 'to be radiant'. Named for the brightness and luminousness of the soul, or for the radiant light of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh).
